Name: REFIN
Function: External reference voltage input for the current-sense amplifier (abs max 3.6 V)

Name: IOUT
Function: Current-sense amplifier output; V(IOUT)-V(REFIN) is proportional to phase current

Name: LSET
Function: Resistor from LSET to PGND sets the inductor value used by the internal current-sense circuit

Name: VDD
Function: Supply for gate drivers and internal circuitry; 4.5-5.5 V

Name: VOS
Function: Output-voltage sense for the internal current-sense circuit; connect to VOUT

Name: SW
Function: Phase/switch node (HS source, LS drain); connect to output inductor. Comb-shaped pad

Name: VIN
Function: Power input 4.5-16 V; place input capacitors close to this pin. Comb-shaped pad

Name: BOOTR
Function: Return of HS gate driver, internally connected to VSW; bootstrap capacitor goes BOOT to BOOTR

Name: BOOT
Function: Bootstrap capacitor connection; min 0.1 uF 16 V X5R from BOOT to BOOTR; bootstrap diode integrated

Name: PWM
Function: Tri-state PWM input from controller (3.3 V and 5 V compatible); Hi-Z longer than t3HT turns both FETs off

Name: EN/FCCM
Function: High = enable in forced-CCM; tri-state window = diode-emulation mode; low = both FETs off; internal pull-down

Name: TAO/FLT
Function: Temperature amplifier output with integrated ORing diode (TAO pins of all phases may be tied); pulled to 3.3 V on thermal shutdown, LSOC or HSS fault. Pin table spells it TAO/FAULT

Name: PGND
Function: Power ground; exposed thermal pad (must be soldered)
